infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CoursePal needs camera access so you can scan physical syllabus documents to build your course schedule automatically.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CoursePal needs photo library access to import syllabus images.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: CoursePal needs calendar access to schedule assignment due dates and reading schedules into your Apple Calendar.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: CoursePal needs reminders access to alert you before upcoming assignment deadlines.
